risks.title: Interest Rate Risk on Variable Rate Debt
risks.score_rationale: Risk is explicitly mentioned in ITEM 7A with significant exposure to variable rate debt (SOFR + margin). Impact of a 100 bp increase is quantified at +$6M annually, which is material. The Capital category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Volatility of Raw Material Prices
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in ITEM 7A, exposure to fluctuations in resin, aluminum, gas prices, etc. Absence of derivatives to hedge these risks amplifies exposure. Language is explicit about unhedged exposure.

risks.title: Accounting Estimates on Trade Incentives
risks.score_rationale: Trade incentives represent 5% of revenue and require complex estimates (volume, performance evidence). Accrual amount ($33M) is material. Language emphasizes estimation uncertainty.

risks.title: Potential Impairment of Intangible Assets
risks.score_rationale: Although no impairment was recorded in 2025, the company emphasizes subjectivity of assumptions (capitalization multiples, discount rates). The annual test is critical for brands and goodwill.

risks.title: Long-term Contractual Obligations
risks.score_rationale: The contractual obligations table shows $2.322B in liabilities, of which $2.125B is long-term debt. This reflects heavy reliance on financing. Explicit mention in Item 1A.

ai_positioning.summary: Reyn does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. There is no significant mention of AI in the provided text.
